MWI.note: No business payment system is stated.
IFMIS is named only as a Lilongwe City Council reporting platform, not stated in use across central government.

facts.fact: Lilongwe City Council's expression of interest says it maintains a rates database of about 47,000 properties and an existing property rates management system, with ratepayer accounts and the IRMS as its primary revenue collection system, and plans a new system.
facts.system: Lilongwe City Council property rates system and IRMS

MWI.note: No payments uptake figure is stated.
No retail payment system is stated; the notice only says the rates system has no bank or mobile money interface.
Only a city council's rates system is described, not state taxes or fees paid electronically.
